name: Csővár (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Csővár (a blue and green shield with a yellow castle, a wavy stripe and a stag) above a yellow scroll inscribed CSŐVÁR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
